qualityThreshold: Peer-reviewed empirical study or structured review, relevant youth overlap or institutional youth need, accessible methods inspected, substantive design-specific use and limitations recorded, no unresolved material reporting problem. countingMethod: Each DOI/PMID publication counted once, reprint excluded. Cross-listing does not increase counts. records.registryScope: Identifiers explicitly reported in article abstract; other registrations remain unverified

records.authors: Fan H, Zhang J, Wang Y, Yang K, Wang Y, Yang X.
records.registryScope: Identifiers explicitly reported in article abstract; other registrations remain unverified

population.age: Chinese university students; exact age range requires table verification.
population.sample: Methods report 97 included and 95 analyzed; abstract describes 95 randomized.
population.setting: Not separately established; see population/intervention description

intervention.descriptionAndDose: Four 50-minute trained-peer sessions of EMD plus imagery rescripting, imagery rescripting alone, or self-help care as usual; one-month follow-up.

records.journal: International journal of environmental research and public health
records.registryScope: Identifiers explicitly reported in article abstract; other registrations remain unverified

population.sample: 387 recruited/randomised; analysis denominators vary by endpoint

records.title: A systematic review of longitudinal risk and protective factors for loneliness in youth.
records.authors: Buecker S, Petersen K, Neuber A, Zheng Y, Hayes D, Qualter P.
records.journal: Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences
records.registryScope: Identifiers explicitly reported in article abstract; other registrations remain unverified

population.setting: Not separately established; see population/intervention description

intervention.descriptionAndDose: Not applicable or not established from inspected sections
intervention.provider: Not separately established; clinician/teacher/app details, if known, are retained in the intervention description

design.description: Systematic review of longitudinal observational studies
design.masking: Not applicable or not established from inspected methods; no masking inferred

records.findings: Peer rejection/victimisation and several mental-health difficulties consistently preceded later loneliness; many proposed factors lacked replicated evidence.

records.title: The role of school connectedness in the prevention of youth depression and anxiety: a systematic review with youth consultation.
records.authors: Raniti M, Rakesh D, Patton GC, Sawyer SM.
records.registryScope: Identifiers explicitly reported in article abstract; other registrations remain unverified

population.age: Outcomes at 14–24 or mean near range; typically younger adolescents
population.sample: 34 longitudinal studies and two intervention studies
population.setting: Not separately established; see population/intervention description

intervention.descriptionAndDose: Not applicable or not established from inspected sections
intervention.provider: Not separately established; clinician/teacher/app details, if known, are retained in the intervention description

design.masking: Not applicable or not established from inspected methods; no masking inferred

records.findings: School connectedness usually predicted fewer later depressive/anxiety symptoms; two interventions improved depression.
records.limitations: Predominantly observational US evidence, limited diagnostic/remission outcomes and few interventions; an independent academy differs from school.

records.title: Quality Social Connection as an Active Ingredient in Digital Interventions for Young People With Depression and Anxiety: Systematic Scoping Review and Meta-analysis.
records.authors: Dewa LH, Lawrance E, Roberts L, Brooks-Hall E, Ashrafian H, Fontana G, Aylin P.
records.registryScope: Identifiers explicitly reported in article abstract; other registrations remain unverified

population.setting: Not separately established; see population/intervention description

intervention.descriptionAndDose: Not applicable or not established from inspected sections
intervention.provider: Not separately established; clinician/teacher/app details, if known, are retained in the intervention description

design.masking: Not applicable or not established from inspected methods; no masking inferred

records.findings: Quality connection involved rapport, common identity, being valued and receiving responses; anonymity/privacy could help, while negative interactions or disconnection could hinder.
records.limitations: Mostly uncontrolled/cross-sectional evidence and only 10% double-screening. Pooled symptom changes cannot isolate a causal social-connection effect; percentage-style abstract wording is not an individual clinical improvement rate.
records.harmsAndAttrition: Not systematically extracted beyond findings/limitations; absence of reporting is not evidence of no harm

labRelevance.implication: Design responsive, moderated community experiences and measure their quality, including exclusion and negative interactions.
labRelevance.transferLimit: Component evidence does not establish efficacy of the combined Universal Mind lab model.
